solver_parameters.physics_qualification: Two-component tangential surface-current BEM with regularized dyadic cross coupling, scaled cross interactions, and single-layer self operators; an approximate model, not the complete electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT equations. Use SCUFF-EM for first-principles electromagnetic results.
solver_parameters.channel_weights: normal-incidence TM and TE Fresnel amplitudes
solver_parameters.symmetry_method: sum of four cyclic Fourier-block traces
solver_parameters.off_diagonal_quadrature: panel centroid with finite-panel distance sqrt(distance^2 + (A_target + A_source)/(8*pi))
solver_parameters.normal_derivatives: analytic finite-panel-regularized scalar kernel derivatives projected onto tangent bases; diagnostics only
solver_parameters.diagnostic_decomposition: partition of translation derivative by rotor panel; not an independently observable Maxwell-stress face force

result.force_direction: z; negative means attraction toward stator
result.physics_qualification: Two-component tangential surface-current BEM with regularized dyadic cross coupling, scaled cross interactions, and single-layer self operators; an approximate model, not the complete electromagnetic FSC/PMCHWT equations. Use SCUFF-EM for first-principles electromagnetic results.
result.convergence_note: No resolution/frequency convergence study has been performed.
